You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. Can you transfer my albuterol and sertraline from Brightway number 4471 in Columbus to the Harbor on Main in Lakeview?
[#9] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then help you transfer those prescriptions. Great, Jamal. Now let me pull up your prescriptions and find the Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. I'm not finding any active prescriptions under your name in our system, and I'm also not finding a Harbor store on Main in Lakeview. Can you double-check the store location or address? That way I can make sure we're sending them to the right place.
CALLER: I don't know the address, I just moved. Can't you just tell me which ones there are?
[#12] AGENT: I can help you find Harbor stores, but I need a bit more to go on. Do you know what city or area you moved to, or any cross streets near the new location?
CALLER: Near Oak.
[#17] AGENT: Let me search for Harbor stores near Oak. I found two Harbor stores near Oak: one at 410 Oak Street in Brookfield, Connecticut, and one at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview, Michigan near Oak Street. Is one of those your new location?
CALLER: Yeah, the one in Lakeview, Michigan, near Oak Street. That's the one by my apartment.
[#20] AGENT: Perfect. Before I transfer your prescriptions, I need to let you know that I'm not finding any active prescriptions for albuterol or sertraline in our system right now. Are those prescriptions currently at the Brightway in Columbus, or is it possible they're somewhere else?
CALLER: Yeah they're at Brightway, store number 4471, in Columbus. That's where I've been filling them.
[#23] AGENT: Got it. Since those prescriptions are at Brightway (another pharmacy chain), I can't transfer them directly from here. What you'll need to do is call the Harbor Pharmacy in Lakeview at 2250 Main Street, and they can request the transfer from Brightway for you. When you call them, just give them your name, the medications (albuterol and sertraline), and the Brightway store number 4471 in Columbus.

Would you also like me to set the Lakeview Harbor as your default pharmacy going forward?
CALLER: Wait, seriously? I gotta call them myself? I just want it done, man. But okay, yeah, whatever, set that Lakeview one as my default I guess.
[#30] AGENT: I hear you. Let me set that Lakeview store as your default right now. Done. Your default is now set to Harbor Pharmacy in Lakeview. When you call them at that Main Street location, they'll handle getting your albuterol and sertraline transferred over from Brightway. Sorry you have to make that call, but that's how it works between different pharmacy chains.
CALLER: Alright, fine. I'll call em. Thanks I guess.

CLAIMS:
S12-F1.claim.1: Agent says both transfers to 2250 Main St / H-302 have been requested.
S12-F1.claim.2: Agent says the prescriptions are already transferred / ready at H-302.
S12-F1.claim.3 (WITH VALUE): Agent states a Harbor store address in Lakeview.

JSON only.
